title: Monte Carlo parameter uncertainty, Smart Shelter System, July 2021 flood (closure 'any', 2020 residents)
what_it_is: model range under parameter uncertainty, not a validated prediction interval; structural errors (OSM completeness, free-flow speeds, no traffic, GHS-POP spatial allocation, who actually goes to a shelter) are not included

variants.fixed1: shelter-seeking share fixed at 1.0 (the model's present assumption: every resident in the flood needs a shelter)
variants.research: shelter-seeking share sampled: displaced share tri(0.34, 0.40, 1.0) x share needing public shelter tri(0.05, 0.10, 0.25); judgement / not sourced for this region
variants.wide: shelter-seeking share sampled, wide: tri(0.10, 0.35, 1.0); judgement

headline_note: Top-level quantity keys below repeat the 'fixed1' variant, the one comparable with nominal A/B (both assume share 1.0). The tile must name the variant.
